assets.name: garlanded-grotesque-with-birds-musicians-and-central-mask
assets.description: A tall native grotesque with garlanded upper birds, two musicians, a central winged mask, paired lower figures and narrow original figure friezes.

extraction.method: Native-resolution continuous ink coverage after locally measured paper removal; PNG appearance master.
extraction.source_rgb_modified: Paper removed by measured ink coverage; RGB is the scan-measured ink tone, not an exact source-pixel crop.

red_stamp_removal.method: Only source pixels with red exceeding both green and blue by 30 levels excluded as the inspected red collection stamp. Original neutral ink under/around the stamp retained; no missing strokes reconstructed.

todo_correction.method: Recover only observed long plate rules from the original scan in a narrow source-fitted native corridor. The input is expanded 25 pixels to include clipped original ink. Source-measured ink color and coverage; no inferred missing side, generic rectangle, artwork rescaling or changed interior pixels.

rule_repair.method: Only absent/faint outside-rule samples (<65 alpha in five-native-pixel corridor) receive the narrow three-pixel ink cross-section of a nearby surviving original printed rule. Decorative hatching and ornament interiors are unchanged.

review.notes: Original finite engraved composition retained with its source-supported outside plate rules. Clipped rules recovered from adjacent original scan pixels; faint thin-rule gaps narrowly completed with neighboring native ink profiles where recorded. Decorative hatch bands retain original print wear. No generic replacement frame or repeat is inferred.

assets.usage_notes: Original finite engraved composition retained with its source-supported outside plate rules. Clipped rules recovered from adjacent original scan pixels; faint thin-rule gaps narrowly completed with neighboring native ink profiles where recorded. Decorative hatch bands retain original print wear. No generic replacement frame or repeat is inferred. Finite original decoration; no repeat or corner atlas inferred.

review_history.notes: Native source linework compared in full on source/white/dark. Natural continuous measured ink coverage; no resized hard mask, polygon trace or source stretch. Foreground strokes and props preserved; isolated page specks excluded by connected native support. Red stamp color excluded only where distinguishable from neutral foreground ink. Bare cartouche title removed with individually inspected text-line bounds, leaving the complete original frame. Original faded ink remains faint rather than newly enhanced.
